import hashlib
import hmac
import os
import secrets
import smtplib
import sqlite3
import time
from email.message import EmailMessage

TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 3600
DB_PATH = os.environ.get("APP_DB_PATH", "app.db")


def _connect():
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.execute(
        "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS password_reset_tokens ("
        "token_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, "
        "expires_at REAL NOT NULL, used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)"
    )
    return conn


def _hash_token(token):
    return hashlib.sha256(token.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def create_reset_token(user_id):
    token = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    expires_at = time.time() + TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
    with _connect() as conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE user_id = ? OR expires_at < ?", (user_id, time.time()))
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT INTO password_reset_tokens (token_hash, user_id, expires_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
            (_hash_token(token), user_id, expires_at),
        )
    return token


def send_reset_email(to_address, token):
    base_url = os.environ.get("APP_BASE_URL", "https://example.com")
    link = f"{base_url}/reset-password?token={token}"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "Reset your password"
    msg["From"] = os.environ["SMTP_FROM"]
    msg["To"] = to_address
    msg.set_content(
        f"We received a request to reset your password.\n\n"
        f"Use this link within {TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS // 60} minutes:\n{link}\n\n"
        f"If you did not request this, ignore this email."
    )
    host = os.environ["SMTP_HOST"]
    port = int(os.environ.get("SMTP_PORT", "587"))
    with smtplib.SMTP(host, port, timeout=10) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(os.environ["SMTP_USER"], os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"])
        server.send_message(msg)


def request_password_reset(email, lookup_user_id):
    user_id = lookup_user_id(email)
    if user_id is None:
        return
    token = create_reset_token(user_id)
    send_reset_email(email, token)


def verify_reset_token(token):
    if not token:
        return None
    token_hash = _hash_token(token)
    with _connect() as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT token_hash, user_id, expires_at, used FROM password_reset_tokens WHERE token_hash = ?",
            (token_hash,),
        ).fetchone()
        if row is None or not hmac.compare_digest(row[0], token_hash):
            return None
        if row[3] or row[2] < time.time():
            return None
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE password_reset_tokens SET used = 1 WHERE token_hash = ? AND used = 0",
            (token_hash,),
        )
        if cur.rowcount != 1:
            return None
        return row[1]
